channels.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Ibuda n usbeddi
channels.sh.content:
Open Voice OS yesɛa sin n yibuda igejdanen n usuffeɣ:

  - asenqed (yettwasemren)
  - alfa (tama n usnulfu)

Abadu n usenqed yettwasemren i tuget n yiseqdacen. Yegber timahilin timaynutin d yiselhiyen, yerna s wudem amatu yettwakal, maca yezmer ad yili deg-s kra n tuɣalin s deffir tikkwal.

Abadu alfa d lqem armitan maḍi, yegber timahilin d yibeddilen ineggura i mazal deg usnefli. Yezmer ad ur yerkid ara yerna ur yettwasemren ara i useqdec n yal ass.

Ttxil-k fren abadu:

finish.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Tagara
finish.sh.content:
Asbeddi-nni yekfa akken iwata! 🎉

Amalal-inek n taɣect yewjed ad yelḥi. Nefṛeḥ imi ay d-tesnirmeḍ tiɣawsiwin akked tzemmar n umalal-a n taɣect.

Ma yella tremdeḍ tamahilt n tmusniwin timezwura, tzemreḍ ad tebduḍ ad temmeslayeḍ akked umalal-ik s taɣect.

- Azul a Mycroft, acḥal ssaɛa?
- A Mycroft, anda i tewweḍ teẓɣelt?
- A Mycroft, anwa i k-id-isnulfan?
- A Mycroft, menhu i d Ada Lovelace?
- A Mycroft, d acu ara d-yini Duke Nukem?

Iɣewwaren n umalal-ik zemren ad ttwabeddlen deg ufaylu n tawila n ${CONFIG_FILE:-}.

Ma teḥwajeḍ tallalt neɣ ileqman sya d asawen, ḥulfu i yiman-ik tzemreḍ ad ten-id-tnermseḍ. Faṛes tarmit-ik n Open Voice OS!

methods.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Tarrayin
methods.sh.content:
Akken ad tesbeddeḍ Open Voice OS, ɣur-k snat n tarrayin timezwura.

    - Amsedday n imagbaren am Docker
    - Naɣ asbeddi deg twennaḍt tuhlist n Python

Imagbaren ttaken-d aɛzal d usenfali afessas, ma d tawennaḍt tuhlist n Python tettak-d ugar n tiflellit d usenqed n usbeddi.

Ma tettwafren tarrayt n yimagbaren, Docker ad yettwasbedd s wudem awurman ma ulac-it deg unagraw.

Ttxil fren tarrayt n usebded:

profiles.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Imeɣna
profiles.sh.content:
I wakken ad d-tesbeddeḍ anagraw amataṛ yettwafes i waṭas n yisemras, llant ṛebɛa n tferkitin yettɛejben:

  - Open Voice OS Master: Tarmit tasimant n Open Voice OS
  - HiveMind Satellite: Iferdisen n imesli n Open Voice OS yettwaqqnen ɣer HiveMind Listener
  - HiveMind Listener: Ammas i HiveMind Satellite, iboten, d wayen nniḍen.. i wakken ad ttwaqqnen
  - Aqeddac: Open Voice OS Core d HiveMind Core kan, ur yesɛi ara timeẓliyin n imesli

Yal amaɣnu seg yimeɣnasen-a yesɛa timeẓliyin d tezmara timsirin i yezmer ad yessnerni mliḥ tarmit-ik tamḍyant.

Asteqsi d, anwa deg-sen i yettwafes i imeḍranen-ik d tferkit-ik?

Ttxil-k fren amaɣnu:

telemetry.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Aktili
telemetry.sh.content:
Ma tferneḍ ad tebḍuḍ yid-neɣ isefka n tilumṭa, ad teturarḍ amur axatar deg uttekki s telɣut tusligt yesɛan azal, i ɣ-yettmaggaren ad negzu ugar tirmitin n yiseqdacen yerna ad nesselhu tamellit n useɣẓan-nneɣ.

Isefka-nnek n tilumṭa gebren talɣut telqayen ɣef wamek ixeddem useɣẓan deg tignatin tilawin. Isefka-a ttwaleqḍen s wudem udrig, s uḥraz n tbaḍnit-inek d tuffra-inek.

Talɣut i nettleqḍu tettɛawan-aɣ ad nafen uguren i yezmer ad d-ilin, ad nesselhu timeẓliyin, yerna ad nesseḍmen tarmit n useqdec irekden ugar, ifazen ugar i yal yiwen.

I ugar n telɣut ɣef yisefka i nettelqeḍ, ttxil-k rzu ɣer: https://github.com/OpenVoiceOS/ovos-installer/tree/main/docs/telemetry.md

Aleqḍ-a n yisefka ad yili kan deg ukala n usbeddi.

Tqebleḍ ad tebḍuḍ yid-neɣ isefka udrigen?

tuning.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Tamellit
tuning.sh.content:
Open Voice OS yettak-d amaɣnu n yiɣewwaten i yibenkan n wanaw Raspberry Pi, akken ad yettwasmeskel unagraw n wammud s wudem ifazen akk i usebded n Open Voice OS.

Iswi n ukala-a n yiɣewwaren ad yesselhu tamellit, ad yesneqes aseqdec n yiɣbula, yerna ad yeḍmen tarmit n useqdac irekden ugar.

Snes iɣewwaren i Raspberry Pi (yettwasmetren) ?

overclock.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Nnig n temrilt
overclock.sh.content:
Asali n tazzla n CPU/GPU yessalay tasnamurt-nsen i tmellit tafellayt, maca yezmer ad yessenqes arkad yerna ad yessali taẓɣelt.

Ayen yettwasran:
- Assemmeḍ urmid (aseffaḍ n tẓɣelt/amarway) d tazzla n wuzuf yelhan
- Tala n tnezmert irekden iwatan i umudil-ik Pi
- Sefqed tizesɣal yerna ḥbes ma yella asenqes n tazzla neɣ iɣelluyen

Tilufa:
- Ales asenker s ugacur, tilufa n imesli, tixṣarin n yisefka
- Aseqdec afellay n tnezmert d usenqes n teɣzi n tmeddurt

Open Voice OS ur yelli ara d amasay ɣef kra n wuguren icudden ɣer usali n tazzla.

Ad tremdeḍ asali n tazzla?

uninstall.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Tukksa n usbeddi
uninstall.sh.content:
Tettwaf-d tummant yellan yakan n Open Voice OS.

Acku Docker d PipeWire zemren llan ttwasbedden deg unagraw neɣ s ufus, amsebdad ur itekkes ara ikemmusen-a.

  - docker-ce
  - docker-compose-plugin
  - docker-ce-rootless-extras
  - docker-buildx-plugin
  - pipewire
  - pipewire-alsa

Tebɣiḍ ad tekkseḍ asbeddi n Open Voice OS?

update.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Amucceḍ
update.sh.content:
Tettwaf-d tumant yellan yakan n Open Voice OS/HiveMind.

Aleqqem n tumant-ik n Open Voice OS neɣ HiveMind yellan yakan ɣer lqem aneggaru yesseḍmay ad teqqimeḍ deg uqerru s timeẓliyin tinafellaḍin, ileqqman ixataren n tɣellist, aseggem n tuccḍiwin, d useggem n temlilt.

Aya ur yesnerni kan tawuri d tarmit n useqdec s wudem amatu, maca yesseḍmay daɣen amṣada akked yimseddiyen d yifecka ineggura, ad yeǧǧ anagraw-ik arkad, aɣelsan, yerna iheyya i yimal.

Tebɣiḍ ad tleqqmeḍ Open Voice OS ɣer lqem aneggaru?

usage_telemetry.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Tidaddanin n useqdec
usage_telemetry.sh.content:
S ufran-ik beṭṭu n yisefka n useqdec, ad tiliḍ d amettekki axatar deg wussisen-nneɣ i usnerni n tawuri d tarmit n useqdec n useɣẓan-nneɣ. Isefka ara aɣ-tefkeḍ ad qqimen d udrigen yerna sɛan azal axatar i wakken ad aɣ-ɛiwnen ad nesseggem amṣada n tmeɣriwin, i wakken ad naf tuccḍiwin n unagraw, yerna ad nefren igayen ifazen ɣef yisnefliyen n yimal.

I uttekki-k, ad ak-nmud talɣut yesɛan azal ɣef tikliwin n useqdec, timeɣriwin yecḍen, d tesleḍt yudsen s ufakan amyagraw. Talɣut-a tezmer ad k-tɛiwen ad tseggmeḍ amallal akken ad iwatem ugar i yimeḍranen-ik uzzigen, ad yeǧǧ tarmit n useqdec d tumert yerna d tamellilt ugar.

I ugar n telɣut ɣef usken n yisefka d tferkitin n usader, ttxil-k rzu ɣer uwwur-nneɣ n yisefka yeldin: https://opendata.tigregotico.pt

Nefka azal i uttekki-k yerna nessaram ad ternuḍ yid-neɣ i usnulfu n tarmit n useɣẓan ifazen i yal yiwen!

Tqebleḍ ad tebḍuḍ yid-neɣ isefka udrigen?

welcome.sh.title: Asbeddi n Open Voice OS - Ansuf
welcome.sh.content:
Azul, ansuf yis-wen ɣer usbeddi n Open Voice OS!

Nefṛeḥ imi i ad ak-nesken Open Voice OS, amalal aɣectan n uɣbalu yeldin, win i yettbeddilen abrid ideg nettemlili akked tetiknulujit.

Asebded n unagraw n Open Voice OS fessus am waman, yerna ad yeldi amaḍal n tzemmar i usenqed s taɣect. Ama telliḍ seg wid iḥemlen tteknulujit neɣ tettnadiḍ kan ad tesselḥuḍ lecɣal-ik n yal ass, ha-t-an ihi da Open Voice OS akken ad awen-yessishil tudert-nwen.

Bdu asbeddi tura, teǧǧeḍ taɣect-ik ad k-id-tmel sya d asawen imal n tetiknulujit!🌟
